title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations: Calibration Bay, Target and Road-Drive Schedule
content:
For ADAS Sensor Calibrations, a static procedure is performed in a calibration bay and a dynamic procedure on the road. The schedule below gives, tier by tier, the bay and target set-up for a static attempt, the road conditions for a dynamic attempt, and whether a mobile technician can perform the calibration at the customer's location.

## Static attempt: bay and targets

| Tier | Level calibration bay with targets required | Target boards or reflectors set up for the static procedure | Bay time reserved for one static attempt (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dynamic Camera Calibration | no | 0 | 0 |
| Static Camera Calibration | yes | 1 | 90 |
| Dual-Mode Camera Calibration | yes | 1 | 120 |
| Blind Spot Radar Calibration | yes | 2 | 75 |
| Front Radar Calibration | yes | 1 | 90 |
| Multi-System Calibration | yes | 4 | 240 |

A bay time of 0 minutes means the tier has no static procedure.

## Dynamic attempt: road conditions

| Tier | Minimum steady speed for the dynamic procedure (mph) | Longest drive allowed for the dynamic procedure to complete before the attempt counts as failed (minutes) | Dynamic procedure not attempted in rain, snow or fog |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dynamic Camera Calibration | 40 | 30 | yes |
| Static Camera Calibration | 0 | 0 | no |
| Dual-Mode Camera Calibration | 40 | 30 | yes |
| Blind Spot Radar Calibration | 0 | 0 | no |
| Front Radar Calibration | 0 | 0 | no |
| Multi-System Calibration | 40 | 45 | yes |

A minimum speed of 0 mph and a longest drive of 0 minutes both mean the tier has no dynamic procedure.

## Mobile calibration

| Tier | Calibration can be done by a mobile technician at the customer's location |
|---|---|
| Dynamic Camera Calibration | yes |
| Static Camera Calibration | no |
| Dual-Mode Camera Calibration | no |
| Blind Spot Radar Calibration | no |
| Front Radar Calibration | no |
| Multi-System Calibration | no |

## Points of judgement drawn from the schedule

- A Multi-System Calibration dynamic attempt has up to 45 minutes of driving to complete; a Dynamic Camera Calibration or Dual-Mode Camera Calibration dynamic attempt has up to 30 minutes. In each case the steady speed is at least 40 mph.
- Dynamic Camera Calibration is the only tier with no calibration bay requirement and the only tier available from a mobile technician.
- The weather restriction is "yes" on exactly the tiers that have a dynamic procedure.
